title: StrategyPackageRepository.transition_status not atomic — partial mutation on event-insert failure
description: AIstock pg_pool connections default to autocommit=True. StrategyPackageRepository.transition_status() updated package_status before inserting package_status_event. If the event insert failed (e.g. UniqueViolation from sequence collision per BUG-022), package_status was already mutated and not rolled back, leaving the repository in an inconsistent state where the package shows the new status without the corresponding audit event row. Codex Phase 3 live smoke discovered this by triggering UniqueViolation on package_status_event during enable_paper, observing package_status persisted but no event recorded. Codex local fix on origin/codex/qe-governance-integration-20260509: disable autocommit around update + event insert, commit on success, rollback on failure, restore original autocommit, wrap UniqueViolation as InvalidStateTransitionError. 32 regression tests added/passed locally but commit not yet pushed. Cross-tool drawer dd17c102a3a16e087d453364 captures the diagnostic + Codex's planned fix.
